OmniVoice optional ONNX backend

The retained omnivoice_duration.py includes its upstream copyright/license header.
wide_omnivoice_onnx.py ports the conditional/unconditional input construction,
classifier-free guidance, shifted unmasking schedule, layer penalty and position
sampling procedure into NumPy for ONNX Runtime inference without PyTorch.

Pretrained OmniVoice weights are CC-BY-NC according to the official model card:
https://huggingface.co/k2-fsa/OmniVoice
ONNX conversion: https://huggingface.co/gaber/OmniVoice-ONNX-CPU-INT8
Pinned ONNX revision: efddec1c39169c79e57eb65f1a7b650d0906a182
Converter metadata does not remove the upstream weight license conditions.
The optional resource pack includes the Higgs Audio 2 and Llama 3 license texts
provided by the exporter. No commercial relicensing is asserted.
